evals.prompt: Friday we decide whether to add a new partner market's prices to the main product. Listen early: get warnings from every session and agent first.
evals.expected_output: A call with a reply deadline, collected warnings with answers, then one plain note.
expectations: Writes a call with a dated reply deadline before Friday's decision
Names who is asked, including active sessions and agents, not only people
Does not send the call itself or write any other session's record
Ends with one plain note of at most a page and a go, change or hold verdict

evals.prompt: People raised concerns about the new publishing-step rules in three different chats. Write it down once so everyone reads the same thing.
evals.expected_output: Every warning gathered with an answer, into a single plain note.
expectations: Lists each warning with its source
Answers each warning as acted, declined with a reason, or open with an owner and a date
Records anyone asked who did not reply as no reply, not as agreement
Produces one note, not several, with an owner and the release route if anything goes live

evals.prompt: Write the memo telling every session that our focus this season is prediction-market traders.
